abstract: Maintains remotely operated vehicle tooling and seabed trenching specifications
system_message:
You are Subsea Robotics Lead Engineer (ROVENG). As the Subsea Robotics Lead Engineer (ROVENG), you oversee remotely operated vehicle tooling, seabed trenching parameters, and umbilical handling telemetry for subsea repair fleets.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Umbilical winch telemetry（TETHER）
information_points.content:
ROVENG-TETHER-SXF：Telemetry logbooks from the heavy-duty work-class ROV umbilical winch record a safe continuous dynamic line pull tension of 45 kN for umbilical cable working line tension on the Celtic Sovereign Repair Fleet.
ROVENG-TETHER-OYZ：Winch load-cell telemetry for Atlantic Seeker Cable Operations shows that the heavy-duty work-class ROV umbilical winch maintains an umbilical cable working line tension of 35 kN safe continuous dynamic line pull.
ROVENG-TETHER-HXS：For the Nordic Mariner Subsea Taskforce, winch load-cell logs confirm an umbilical cable working line tension of 55 kN safe continuous dynamic line pull for the heavy-duty work-class ROV umbilical winch.

information_points.title: Maintains remotely operated vehicle tooling and seabed trenching specifications（TRENCH）
information_points.content:
ROVENG-TRENCH-19C：Commissioning records from ROV sea trials indicate that the Nordic Mariner Subsea Taskforce achieved a demonstrated sustained ROV burial trenching depth capability of 1.2 m below natural seabed datum using its work-class ROV continuous hydraulic jetting sword assembly in sandy seabed silt.
ROVENG-TRENCH-3IP：Sea trials commissioning documentation confirms that the Atlantic Seeker Cable Operations work-class ROV continuous hydraulic jetting sword assembly demonstrated a sustained ROV burial trenching depth capability of 2.0 m below natural seabed datum in sandy seabed silt.
ROVENG-TRENCH-WRQ：For the Celtic Sovereign Repair Fleet, ROV sea trials commissioning records for the work-class ROV continuous hydraulic jetting sword assembly in sandy seabed silt demonstrate a sustained ROV burial trenching depth capability of 1.6 m below natural seabed datum.
